description: Na₃Sc₂V₃O₁₂ crystallizes in the cubic Ia̅3d space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight equivalent O atoms. There are four shorter (2.52 Å) and four longer (2.67 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sc is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ScO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. All Sc-O bond lengths are 2.12 Å. V is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent ScO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. All V-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one V atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ScV trigonal pyramids.
